papers.headline: Episodic Star Formation - II. The Origin of the Fundamental Metallicity Relation
papers.summary: The Fundamental Metallicity Relation (FMR) extends the mass-metallicity relation (MZR) by including star formation rate (SFR) as a third parameter. At fixed stellar mass, galaxies with higher SFRs tend to have lower gas-phase metallicities.
papers.title: Episodic Star Formation - II. The Origin of the Fundamental Metallicity Relation

papers.headline: The Neptunian ridge through the lens of TESS
papers.summary: The Neptunian desert and savanna are separated by a ridge, an overdensity at orbital periods of approximately 3-6 d identified with Kepler.
papers.title: The Neptunian ridge through the lens of TESS

papers.headline: Mercury (Hg): a relativistic N-body simulation for Horndeski gravity
papers.summary: We present Mercury, a relativistic N-body code for cosmological simulations in the α-basis formulation of Horndeski gravity.
papers.title: Mercury (Hg): a relativistic N-body simulation for Horndeski gravity
